tagline: Offline Torah Notes & Hebrew Handwriting OCR Studio
taglineHebrew: סטודיו אופליין לזיהוי ועריכת כתב יד תורני ומחברות שיעורים
releaseTitle: v1.4.1 — Critical Batch-Scan Page-Lock Fix, Pixel-Exact Highlight Alignment, Looseleaf Margin & Binder-Hole Cleaner, and Torah Cursive Auto-Correction
description: Ohr HaKsav (אור הכתב) v1.4.1 fixes the critical batch-scan page-overwrite bug when clicking other pages mid-scan, aligns bounding-box highlights pixel-for-pixel via inverse perspective mapping, automatically removes looseleaf binder holes and red vertical margin lines to eliminate phantom edge letters and junk lines, calibrates F8 uncertain-line highlighting for Mishkefet scores, fixes the double-apostrophe replacement cascade, and adds smart Torah cursive-confusion auto-correction.
features: Fixed Batch-Scan Page-Swap / Overwrite Bug: Clicking another page while 'Scan All Pages' runs no longer overwrites the page you clicked—each OCR worker is now strictly bound to its target page index & file path, and batch scanning runs quietly in the background without hijacking your view.

Pixel-Exact Line Highlight Alignment: OCR line bounding boxes are now mapped back through the exact inverse perspective transform so yellow and blue line overlays land directly on top of their handwritten lines instead of shifting onto binder holes or desk edges.

Automatic Looseleaf Binder-Hole & Red Margin-Line Cleaner: Automatically detects and whitens the 3 black binder holes, vertical red margin line, left-margin ruled lines, and 1.2% dark desk border slivers—eliminating phantom trailing 'ן' characters and eliminating 100% of fake binder-hole lines on half-empty pages while preserving faint blue ballpoint pen strokes.

Smart Torah Cursive-Confusion Auto-Correction & Single-Pass Replacements: Fixes the sequential double-apostrophe bug (תוס'') with a single-pass regex engine and automatically resolves unambiguous cursive OCR confusions (e.g. לבאורה -> לכאורה, ביון -> כיון, הבלי -> הכלי, דברורות -> דצרורות, בופר -> כופר).

Calibrated Low-Confidence Line Highlighting (F8): Adaptive threshold tuned to Mishkefet's real 0.85–0.99 confidence distribution so the amber '⚠ uncertain (F8)' quick-jump highlights the exact trickiest lines on every page.

Fast Lightweight Delta Patch Ready (engineVersion 1.4): Existing v1.4.0 installations automatically download only the small v1.4.1 delta patch (~100 MB) with SHA-256 verification instead of re-downloading the full 468 MB installer.
